_note: Per-condition L/R ank_rom ratio. _estimator: MEAN OF PER-SEED RATIOS: for each run, ank_rom(left)/ank_rom(right); then the mean over the 4 seeds of a condition. This is the estimator scone/lr_asymmetry.py uses. It is NOT ratio-of-means, which differs at printed precision for 3 of 5 quoted values and is what earlier manuscript revisions reported.
